meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Intelligent refactor command. Triggers: refactor, refactoring, cleanup, restructure, extract, simplify, modernize.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重构代码结构，消除坏味道，提升可维护性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果代码变得难以维护，需要系统性地改善结构
copy.tagline_en: Restructure code, eliminate bad smells, and improve maintainability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your codebase has become hard to maintain and needs systematic structural improvement

howto.what: 当你说要重构代码时,Claude 不会直接改,而是先确认你的目标,再分析整个代码库的依赖和测试覆盖,制定步骤后一步步修改,每步都跑测试保证不出错,最后给改动总结。
howto.when: 当你说出 “refactor”、“cleanup” 等关键词,或要求提取、简化代码时触发。若目标含糊,它会先追问清楚。

say.text: 把 src/auth/handler.ts 里的验证逻辑抽成独立模块
say.note: Claude 会先分析依赖,再逐步实施并验证。

say.text: 重构 AuthService 类,让每个方法只做一件事
say.note: 它会在改动后运行测试,确保没破坏功能。

say.text: 清理项目中所有已废弃 API 的调用
say.note: 触发 cleanup 流程,定位所有废弃用法。

howto.what_en: Claude clarifies intent, maps the codebase, checks test coverage, then refactors step-by-step with LSP and AST-grep, running tests after every step to avoid regressions.
howto.when_en: Triggers on keywords like refactor, cleanup, extract, or requests to restructure, simplify, or modernize code. Vague or broad requests prompt clarifying questions.

say_en.text: Extract the validation logic from src/auth/handler.ts into a separate module.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes dependencies, then refactors and verifies.

say_en.text: Refactor the AuthService class so each method does one thing.
say_en.note: It runs tests after changes to ensure nothing breaks.

say_en.text: Clean up all calls to deprecated APIs in the project.
say_en.note: Triggers the cleanup flow and locates all obsolete usages.
